meta.title: Proposed Outcome (Not Yet Implemented): Bilingual PDF PII-Masking System Design
meta.subtitle: Post-red-team end-state workflow — Zero-egress intake & 3-way page routing, Tesseract 5 VI/EN OCR, visual CropBox coords, singleton ML-service, human review, destructive redaction & zero-PyMuPDF verification

views.title: 1. Quarantine Upload & Zero-Egress Intake Gate
views.narrative: Authenticated user uploads a PDF (<=25 MB) via CSRF-protected API. API checks size & %PDF- header only (no native parser in api); zero-egress worker validates encryption, <=100 pages, xref & pixel-bomb limits before storing immutable original.

views.title: 2. Page-Level 3-Way Routing (Native / Scanned / Mixed)
views.narrative: Zero-egress worker classifies every page via get_texttrace() & get_image_info(). Native pages use PyMuPDF visible text; scanned/flattened pages & untrusted 3 Tr OCR layers use 300 DPI deskew + Tesseract 5 (vie+eng, tessdata_best); mixed pages merge both with IoU dedup.

views.title: 3. Singleton ML-Service (Bilingual VI+EN Detection)
views.narrative: Authenticated singleton ml-service routes text blocks by language (VI vs EN vs mixed) to lightweight_cpu (or optional docker-compose.opf.yml) + clean production rules in app/ml_service/rules/, projecting all labels to 6 canonical groups.

views.title: 4. Human-in-the-Loop Review & Immutable Revision Lock
views.narrative: Reviewer inspects safe preview PNGs with visual CropBox SVG overlays, accepts/rejects detections, draws manual boxes for handwriting/signatures, and locks an immutable ReviewRevision snapshot in PostgreSQL.

views.title: 5. Destructive Redaction & Zero-PyMuPDF Verification
views.narrative: PyMuPDF >=1.25.0 redacts vector/outlined paths & pixels (decoupling shared XObjects) and purges hidden data. Zero-PyMuPDF verifier (pdfplumber + poppler + pikepdf/qpdf + VER-06) gates atomic tombstone-checked publish or creates immutable SUPERSEDED -> revision_no+1 DRAFT.

steps.label: Upload PDF (CSRF + Auth)
steps.description: Authenticated user uploads PDF (<=25 MB, <=100 pages).

steps.label: Stream to Quarantine (%PDF- + Size Cap)
steps.description: No native PDF parser in external-network api; enqueue PG SKIP LOCKED job.

steps.label: Deep Intake Gate (Valid, Unencrypted, No Bomb?)
steps.description: Isolated scrubbed-env subprocess checks pages <=100, xref <=50k, inflation & pixel caps.

steps.label: Purge Quarantine & Reject
steps.description: Malformed, encrypted, oversized, or bomb PDFs rejected cleanly.

steps.label: Store Immutable Original + SHA-256
steps.description: Atomic move to private storage; original never mutated.

steps.label: Classify Each Page (Native / Scanned / Mixed)
steps.description: get_texttrace() (3 Tr invisible OCR) + get_image_info(xrefs=True).

steps.label: Native Extract (PyMuPDF + Visual CropBox)
steps.description: set_small_glyph_heights(True), reading order & exact visual CropBox rects.

steps.label: 300 DPI Render + Deskew + Tesseract 5 VI/EN
steps.description: vie+eng tessdata_best on CPU; ignores untrusted 3 Tr OCR layers.

steps.label: Merge Native + Image OCR (IoU Dedup)
steps.description: Native text + embedded image crop OCR; keep native vs ocr provenance.

steps.label: Normalize Offsets + Stage Safe Preview PNG
steps.description: Char-offset-to-token index, visual CropBox coords & staged 150 DPI previews.

steps.label: Route Block Language (VI / EN / Mixed)
steps.description: Bearer-authenticated singleton ml-service; prevents cross-lang F1 drop.

steps.label: VI Hybrid (spacy_vn_19_ner/OPF + vi_rules)
steps.description: Production app/ml_service/rules/vi_rules.py + VN NER -> 6 groups.

steps.label: EN Hybrid (Presidio/OPF + en_rules)
steps.description: Production app/ml_service/rules/en_rules.py + EN NER -> 6 groups.

steps.label: Map Token Offsets -> Visual Rects & Promote Previews
steps.description: Atomic SELECT FOR UPDATE tombstone check before moving previews & committing.

steps.label: Human Review + Manual Handwriting Boxes
steps.description: Safe PNG viewer + SVG viewBox overlays; optimistic revision_no.

steps.label: Lock Immutable ReviewRevision Snapshot
steps.description: Blocks on failed/unreviewed pages; LOCKED row is never mutated.

steps.label: Destructive Redaction (PyMuPDF >=1.25.0)
steps.description: Delete text/outlined paths/pixels, decouple XObjects, recursive hidden-data purge, single %%EOF.

steps.label: Zero-PyMuPDF Verifier + VER-06 Residual Scan
steps.description: pdfplumber + CTM pikepdf/poppler + qpdf; VER-06 runs on native+scanned only if VER-01..05 PASS.

steps.label: VER-01..05 PASS & 0 New Residuals?
steps.description: Fail-closed gate; FAIL strictly outranks INCONCLUSIVE.

steps.label: Discard Temp PDF (SUPERSEDED -> New DRAFT on Residual)
steps.description: Never mutates LOCKED; new residuals create revision_no + 1 DRAFT.

steps.label: Atomic Publish Clean PDF + Verification Report
steps.description: SELECT FOR UPDATE tombstone & latest-LOCKED check before publish.
